title: RosmarOps 0.10: nine agents with a score, all your computers together, and findings you can set aside
excerpt: In three days, RosmarOps went from scoring three AI agents to scoring nine. Here's what changes for you, and what it still doesn't do.
seo_title: RosmarOps 0.10: nine AI agents with a score, and more
seo_description: Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cline and three more agents now get a score. Plus a space to see all your computers together, and findings you can set aside.
alt: A laptop showing a map of nine AI agents, a hand placing a new one and, beside it, two laptops connected to a cloud.
